verdict.rationale: LightSprint only implies multi-item work. It says background cloud agents can clear a bug backlog, design variations can be explored in parallel, and repeatable work can become reusable workflows. None of this documents a true bulk operation, such as selecting many tasks or items and applying one action to all of them. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-select or batch-action capability on board tasks, documented batch editing or closing of tickets or PRs, an API or CLI for batch operations (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and hands-on corroboration.
